facility_capacity_bridge.note: Reserved warehouse capacity differs from throughput. Rawlins is off the BS&T system; outside-carrier rail transit remains separate. External trucking dispatches include independent regional contracts and must not be equated to all terminal tons.
facility_capacity_bridge.terminal_throughput_counting: A rail siding receipt earns the rail movement fee; only contractually handled/transloaded tons enter terminal throughput. Loaded cars sent to customers at the same registered rail delivery campus need not be unloaded by ARU.

trucking.basis: Explicit synthetic short-haul regional dispatch mix, not 15,000 long-haul journeys. Planned cycles include loading, unloading and empty return; actual dispatches record duty, driving, breaks and rest under 49 CFR part 395. Outside carriers cover incompatible or longer jobs; they are not hidden ARU physical capacity.

railway_crew_capacity.residual_allocation: Protected extra board, branch extras, leave relief, qualifications, switching-intensive customer jobs, training, inspections, interruption response and crew rest; not extra revenue volume. Hours-of-service limits control every assignment.

maintenance_delivery.locomotive_heavy_overhaul: Outsourced funded overhaul with the two GP40-2 units sequenced; never remove both road units from normal availability together. In-house mechanics handle inspections, running repairs and acceptance; the eight FTE are not assumed to execute two full rebuilds and all line maintenance concurrently.
maintenance_delivery.mow_catchup_delivery: Specialist contractors execute bulk tie, surfacing and drainage packages under working foreman control. Ten represented MOW employees provide inspection, normal maintenance, protection and acceptance; contractor expense is in capital and is not omitted payroll.
maintenance_delivery.road_fleet_delivery: Six older tractors are replaced one for one; delivery and disposal overlap briefly but the long-run active fleet remains 18. Two truck mechanics cover preventive maintenance with contracted major repairs.

railcar_flow.revenue_car_supply: Transient interchange cars are supplied by shippers, lessors and connecting carriers. The registered 12 owned service cars and six leased bulkhead flats are not claimed to transport all 9,000 annual revenue cars. Custody register records reporting marks on actual arrival; forecasting adds no fictional purchase.

contract_facility_assignments.provenance: Synthetic physical allocation derived from finance contract units and registered facility capacities; no real customer or land right asserted.
